title: Fix 3 bugs in rust_report_gen functions
description: Brownfield Rust dirty scenario: sum, max_item, and min_item each have a bug. Fix them so all 4 tests pass.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix the 3 bugs in src/lib.rs so all 4 tests pass.

  fn sum(items: &[Item]) -> f64:
    — negates values: map(|i| -i.value) should be map(|i| i.value)
    — fix: remove the negation

  fn max_item(items: &[Item]) -> Option<&Item>:
    — uses min_by instead of max_by — returns smallest item
    — fix: change min_by to max_by

  fn min_item(items: &[Item]) -> Option<&Item>:
    — uses max_by instead of min_by — returns largest item
    — fix: change max_by to min_by

Do not modify the test code.
Run: cargo test
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `cargo test` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
